prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Create a new transparent 2D video game sprite sheet, 4 columns by 2 rows, eight isolated poses with WIDE transparent gutters. Use ONLY the attached reference pigeon as the character design. Preserve its exact small head, compact torso, ordinary foldedwing feather design, tiny beak, orange eye, greyblue head, cream belly, dark navy scarf. Do NOT make a larger more majestic bird. Equal physical head diameter and body volume in every pose.
Top row: jumping ascent, apex, downward fall, landing. Bottom row: four subtle wall-clinging breathing animation frames.
The wall-clinging pose is the KEY NEW DESIGN: pigeon upright and facing right. Legs raised forward. Both pink feet are stretched in a VERTICAL orientation, soles and long toes FLAT against an invisible vertical wall on the RIGHT, as if bird is bracing both feet against a sheer vertical plane. Foot shapes resemble vertically pressed flat open palms with tiny claws pointing up, NOT round grasping hooks and NOT walking feet. Both rightmost footsole contact edges must line up on exactly the same x coordinate in each frame. Head/beak is to LEFT of that contact line. Lower foot's bottom edge establishes character collision feet height. No parts extend right of contact line. The wall itself is NOT visible. Keep feet still and vary only torso/scarf/wings subtly. Wings mostly folded, no huge wing.
Top row airborne poses also same torso dimensions as walking reference, wings moderate and do not obscure torso. Feet tuck on ascent and apex, stretch down on fall, flat horizontal feet on landing. No platform, no wall, no ground, no shadow, no labels, no boxes, no particles. Actual transparent background. Handpainted crisp outline and layered feather detail just like reference. Each sprite completely inside its own slot with empty gutters at least40px. Output landscape 2:1 atlas.
